payload.root_cause: vn-price-fetch.service, vn-foreign-flow.service, vn-sbv-fetch.service all crashed within a ~4-minute window on 2026-07-21 ~03:05-03:09 UTC (evidenced by simultaneous stop of vps_push_log ok-rows for prices/foreign-flow/sbv) and never recovered in 36h+ despite Restart=always. Root cause of the NON-RECOVERY: these 3 units (plus vn-bctc-fetch, vn-agm-plan, vn-board-details, vn-vps-proxy) never received the StartLimitIntervalSec=0 hardening that commit 42e8448ce (2026-05-02, task 1822b) applied to vn-news-fetch/vn-reuters-fetch/vn-tradingeconomics-fetch -- that commit's own message explicitly lists the other 6 (bctc, price, foreign-flow, sbv, vps-proxy, ohlcv-backfill, bctc-enrich) as 'had no burst limit and are unchanged', which is itself the misunderstanding: no explicit override means systemd's own default StartLimitIntervalSec=10s/StartLimitBurst=5 applies (stricter than the 300s window the Playwright services were freed from). Any Restart=always unit crashing >=5x within 10s is marked failed by systemd and never restarts itself again -- exactly matching the observed pattern (3 services dead in a 4-min window, zero recovery, while the one already-hardened service (news) kept running through the same window as the control).
payload.original_trigger_unconfirmed: What caused the first crash-loop burst at 03:05-09 UTC on 07-21 (upstream block on HOSE/HNX iboard + Vietcombank XML + SBV portal simultaneously, resource spike, or something else) could not be determined -- requires journalctl -u <unit> --since on the VPS, which is unreachable this cycle (see network_reachability below). Only the non-recovery mechanism (systemd lockout) is evidenced from static config + git history.

network_reachability.finding: SSH to 125.212.251.27:22 timed out from this session (independently reproduced, matches router's earlier finding). HTTP to :8765/:443/:80 also all timed out (no RST -- consistent with stateful DROP, not closed port). ICMP 100% loss. traceroute reaches Vinahost's own network block (125.212.255.22/.222, same /16 as target) at hop 14 then zero response for 6 further hops -- packets reach the datacenter edge and die there.
network_reachability.important_caveat: This does NOT mean the VPS is down -- vn-news-fetch is provably still pushing successfully (verified live, seconds before this signal was written), proving the VPS has working outbound connectivity right now. The unreachability is inbound-direction only (firewall/IP-allowlist/DDoS-mitigation at the Vinahost edge or host), a different and additional failure to the already-known server-side sshExec.ts-spawns-nonexistent-ssh-binary break. Net effect: there is currently NO remote path (automated or manual, from this session) to run systemctl reset-failed/restart on the 3 dead units.
network_reachability.action_needed: Check Vinahost dashboard/firewall/IP-allowlist state, or use the Vinahost provider console (out-of-band, bypasses SSH) to manually run: systemctl reset-failed vn-price-fetch vn-foreign-flow vn-sbv-fetch && systemctl restart vn-price-fetch vn-foreign-flow vn-sbv-fetch. Also verify vn-bctc-fetch.service state (unconfirmed whether it also crash-looped; its last VPS push was 2026-07-20 01:26:41, ~62h).

recommended_fix: Immediate unblock (requires VPS reachability restored first, via SSH or Vinahost console): systemctl reset-failed && systemctl restart for vn-price-fetch, vn-foreign-flow, vn-sbv-fetch; check vn-bctc-fetch state too.

Repo hardening (prevents recurrence): add 'StartLimitIntervalSec=0' to the [Unit] section of vps-scripts/vn-price-fetch.service, vps-scripts/vn-foreign-flow.service, vps-scripts/vn-sbv-fetch.service, vps-scripts/vn-bctc-fetch.service -- exact same one-line change already proven safe by commit 42e8448ce for vn-news-fetch/vn-reuters-fetch/vn-tradingeconomics-fetch.
